messages:
June: Quick one  friend swinging by at 3pm with a potted plant (soil might be messy) and a travel coffee thermos. Where's best to stash the plant so we don't get dirt everywhere? Also theres a small parcel from Oak Couriers on Returns C2 marked only 'Design'  anyone claiming?
Diego (reception): For plants  we usually put a corrugated tray in Closet B1 to catch soil. If it's big I can put it in the greenroom back shelf. I'll pre-print a badge  name?
June: Name's "Samir Patel" arriving 3:05. Thanks Diego.
Chris (mail): Parcel scanned: "Oak Couriers" at 2:40pm. Location Returns C2. Item: 1x "box (fragile)". No recipient on barcode. I'll hold at the desk for today, move to Secure Storage S1 overnight if unclaimed.
Kai: Seating poll  Sunny Bench by windows or High-top by kitchen? Sunny bench good for a quick sit, high-top closer to coffee (and less chance of accidental soil on cushions). Vote with :one: for Sunny Bench, :two: for High-top.
Marta: :two: High-top. Easier cleanup if soil spills. Also happy to bring a small tray for the plant.
Diego (reception): Badge queued: "Samir Patel - guest (June) - 3:05" with sticky note "plant - tray in Closet B1". I'll keep the Oak Couriers parcel at the desk and tag it "Design - unclaimed".
MailBot: Delivery scanned: "Oak Couriers"  14:40. Action: Hold at Returns C2. Auto-move to Secure Storage S1 after 24h. (automated)
June: Thanks all  Marta can you bring the tray? Diego  please ring when Samir arrives. Chris  if no one claims parcel by end of day please DM #design-ops.
Chris (mail): Will do. Leaving a handwritten sticky on the parcel and logging it in Returns C2.
Diego (reception): Samir checked in at 3:06, plant placed on tray in Closet B1, badge printed. High-top chosen. Enjoy the coffee!
June: Closing loop  all good. Big thanks everyone :seedling: :coffee:
